cases.title: Chrome, fixed-id extension, connector page, exemption scan

ST-01.expected: connector hidden and another ordinary tab visible and focused before the last DevTools client closes

ST-02.expected: no DevTools client (target session or browser-level) for >= 600 s, 0 CDP calls

ST-03.expected: no audio / WebRTC / socket / interval / lock / keepalive API in the loaded extension files

ST-04.expected: each of two phones delivers exactly one byte-exact unsolicited 4096-byte record, page hidden

ST-05.expected: page receipt >= 600 s after the last DevTools client closed and before it re-attached

ST-06.expected: host trace independently places both message emissions before the driver re-attached

ST-07.expected: DevTools HTTP target list (no CDP session) shows the connector received both messages before attach

ST-08.expected: two distinct current-run phone evidence files, validated after the idle interval

problems: raw result lacks the run window / handles / phone delay needed to judge freshness
missing phone evidence: 0 file(s) for 2 phones

ST-09.expected: cold idle: no desktop->phone record was ever sent in this run

ST-10.expected: shutdown_complete, Chrome closed, and no surviving host process counted AFTER Chrome closed

ST-11.expected: preconfigured history shows the connector page hidden and unfocused for >= 600 s with no interruption (events after the pre-attach cut ignored)

ST-12.expected: preconfigured history shows the ordinary tab visible and focused for >= 600 s with no interruption (events after the pre-attach cut ignored)

ST-13.expected: recorded Chrome command line carries no throttling/backgrounding/freezing exemption flag

actual.native_messaging_port: not a timer-throttling exemption (owner-approved RFC clarification, 2026-10-27): event delivery through the Native Messaging port is not an exemption; ordinary timers and the port itself are permitted
actual.scope: flags only; this check does not measure Chrome-internal behaviour, and the same-build port-escape comparison lives in separate probe evidence

ST-15.expected: OS foreground owned by the run's own Chrome PID (directly or through its ancestry) before any BLE work and again after the ordinary-tab switch, before every DevTools client closes

ST-14.expected: formal strict run: min_background_s >= 600 and not a diagnostic short run

host_trace.method: driver wall time at hello + host trace ms offset since its hello line (approximate)

phone_evidence_errors: adb pull #1: no readable evidence file
adb pull #2: no readable evidence file

problems: raw result lacks the run window / handles / phone delay needed to judge freshness
missing phone evidence: 0 file(s) for 2 phones
